## Personality

Mirabel Cotton is noted for her boisterous and uninhibited demeanor. She is described as being noisy, sunburned, and reckless, drawing comparisons to the behavior typical of a boy.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)_

## History

Mirabel Cotton gained a reputation for telling frightening tales, scaring [Dora](../character/dora.md) with stories about a ghost relative. She later went fishing with [Dora](../character/dora.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) was convinced to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Tommy](../character/tommy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mirabel-cotton--tommy.md)

[Tommy](../character/tommy.md) Cotton is the brother of Mirabel Cotton. During a [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) outing, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) persuades [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip their classes in order to go fishing with Mirabel and [Tommy](../character/tommy.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), +2 more_
